text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Filali says in parliament privatisation is part of economic global reforms.
- Statistics Directorate says unemployment drops to 18 percent in urban areas in second half of 1996 from 19.4 percent.
- Bad weather and poor infrastructure raise question of getting services nearer to rural population stranded in remote places.
- Malian Prime Minister Keita postpones visit to Morocco following air traffic controllers' strike in Africa.
- Morocco and China sign accord on technical cooperation.
